messages:
claire_cs: Heads-up: HorizonPark dropped ~90% of inference calls after their SSO cutover this AM. They filed ticket HP-824. Billing unchanged but nightly jobs stalled.
nate_csm: Oof. They flagged a competitor pilot too and procurement wants remediation within 48h. I tried the ML lead (carlos) - no reply yet.
rishi_solutions: Offered a 15-min unblock session + sandbox creds. They asked for an SSO checklist we can run together. I'll draft it.
emma_eng: From our traces we see auth-exchange failures around 02:30 UTC, then routing fallback -> 502s. If they paste one raw request/response we can repro. We can also stand up an auth-proxy and temporary key. ETA ~5h after sign-off.
claire_cs: Customer note: "After migrating to IDP-X, jobs return 401/502. We're testing alternatives if unresolved." They explicitly called out a week-long evaluation with a rival.
nate_csm: Sales asked if we can offer a 14-day dedicated pool as a bridge. Can we limit to a short, no-discount trial?
rishi_solutions: Fine with 14-day bridge if it's time-limited and documented. I'll include rollback steps and a quick-run checklist: sample payload, token rotation, enable proxy, retry settings.
emma_eng: Confirmed: we can enable alternate auth endpoint and sandbox key in ~4-6h after customer approval. Need raw request/response to reproduce token exchange issue.
triage-bot: Ticket HP-824 updated by claire_cs at 2025-04-11T09:40Z
claire_cs: Plan: 1) Rishi request sample request/response from HorizonPark. 2) Emma readies proxy + key. 3) Nate coordinates sales/commercial note for 14-day bridge. 4) Claire schedules 30-min troubleshooting session with ML lead. Will update thread when meeting booked. :thumbsup:
